source_text: Ethical arguments equating male circumcision to female genital mutilation (FGM) are dismissed as a false equivalency, given FGM's lack of health benefits, high rates of severe complications, and intent to control female sexuality, versus male circumcision's documented preventive effects and low harm profile. [155]
